notes:
Seti Astro Suite Pro

V1.22.13
Update to Color Mixing Matrix in White Balance. Ideal for broadband targets where a black body locus accurately depicts the spread of colors in the image. This allows much faster color calibration for normal use. If doing absolute photometry, be sure to use SSSC.

New global preference to load an image with the name of the Object_Filter. This is useful for files that may have very long names, especially master lights after stacking to give the view a reasonable name

Other improvements include: Continuum Subtraction photometric star fitting, ADBE Multiscale Gradient Refinement, RGB Combination auto filling in channels, WIMI loading lightening and simbad progress.
